translations.web: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”
translations.bsb: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
translations.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
translations.asv: If ye had known me, ye would have known my Father also: from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.
